## Measure, don't guess

Profile with `cProfile`/`pstats` or `py-spy` (sampling, no code change). Find the real hot path before optimizing.

## Common wins

Use the right data structure (set for membership), avoid quadratic loops, cache with `functools.lru_cache`, and vectorize numeric work with NumPy.

## Micro-benchmark

`timeit` for small snippets. Beware premature optimization — readable code first, then optimize the measured bottleneck.
